name: Nas
headline: Hi, I'm Nasrul.
I build web and mobile apps.
intro: Freelance web & mobile developer. I build a system that helps your business — from the database to the screen in your hand.
currentlyBuilding: Malaysia Sign Language — Learning app for learn Malaysian Sign Language (MSL) through videos, quizzes and flashcards.

paragraphs: I started with Computer Science in secondary school, then joined a work-study programme at Anak2U, where my first framework was Ionic and my job was building the screens of a mobile app. That was enough to get me hooked. I went on to a Diploma in Computer Science at KPMB Beranang, and I'm now studying CS at UPM. What I enjoy most is taking messy, manual work and turning it into something people actually like using. Away from the keyboard I'm usually playing guitar, drums or piano, or singing.

I've been freelancing since my diploma: an IoT project for a student business, an assignment-helper system, a learning platform for a training centre and an internal dashboard for a group of vet clinics. I can take a project from UI design through the backend and mobile app to launch, or join as the developer when you already have designs. I work best with local businesses, training centres, clinics and schools that have outgrown their spreadsheets. If that sounds like you, I'd like to hear about it.
